newsitem.title: KENYA: UK firm wins tender to supply Kenya 80,000T maize.
newsitem.headline: UK firm wins tender to supply Kenya 80,000T maize.

text.p: International Commodity Dealers of London has won a tender to supply Kenya with 80,000 tonnes of maize, the state National Cereals and Produce Board said on Wednesday.
The first consignment of 25,000 tonnes will arrive at the port of Mombasa around Tuesday next week and is sourced from South Africa, the board said in a statement read to Reuters.
"International Commodity Dealers of London won the tender because of the price they quoted and their past record in fulfilling contractual agreements with the board," it said.
"(They) beat four other companies that bid," the board said but did not give any further details.
International Commodity Dealers quoted a price of $180 per tonne, the board said. It added that the first consignment of 25,000 tonnes would arrive in Mombasa aboard the MV Melodia.
"More of the balance of maize imports will also be sourced from South Africa or the Southern Africa region," the board said.
The Board had tendered for the purchase of maize on April 22. It said delays in announcing the winner and subsequent shipments were caused by logistics and legal reasons.
